description: JavaScript source code for TinyMCE media plugin, defining plugin info, initialization, content cleanup, command execution, and node handling functions.

classes.name: TinyMCE_MediaPlugin
classes.description: Object containing media plugin functions for TinyMCE, including info retrieval, initialization, content cleanup, command execution, and node handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes plugin instance, warns if deprecated flash plugin is used, and imports CSS.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for media control button.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes media-related commands, such as opening media insertion window.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up content by replacing script tags with media item placeholders and handling embedded media nodes.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles node change events to update media button state.

methods.name: _createImgFromEmbed
methods.description: Creates an image element from embedded media node.

methods.name: _createImg
methods.description: Creates a placeholder image element for media.

methods.name: _getEmbed
methods.description: Generates embed HTML for media content.

methods.name: _parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses HTML attribute string into an object.
